title: Decochill
description: A modpack that aims to decoration and chilling.
body:
![Decochill](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b6a9c84f0b90eade78e79fb2177b02c3fe2b7e6f.png)
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
This Decochill modpack brings players a chill and decoration experience. Not only chill and decoration, this modpack also has optimization mods.

If there is any issue, feel free to report it to my issue tracker. You can add another mods you want to the modpack.
_________________________________________________________________________________________________
<details>
<summary>Versioning</summary>
The versioning format is <MC version>-x.y(.z), where

the MC version taken is the minor release the version of DC is for,
- x is a mod list revision (addition/removal of a mod)
- y is the config revision (incremented every time a config tweak is added or changed)
- z is incremented when there's a version with only mod updates and little to no changes otherwise.

x.y.z is reset to 1.0.0 for every new MC release as different MC versions are very likely to have different mod sets available for them.
</details>
